title: MCP Action Planner — Connector Registry
description: Defines the shape of connectors.json. Each entry maps a connector name to its platform ID and optional aliases.

connectors.description: List of registered connectors available to the planner

name.description: Exact connector label as it appears on the IBM webMethods platform (case-insensitive match is applied by the planner)

id.description: Platform application ID (appId). Leave empty string to trigger auto-discovery via the /applications/{name} API.

aliases.description: Alternative names a user might use in a natural-language request

description.description: Human-readable description of what this connector does

enabled.description: Set to false to exclude this connector from planner consideration without removing the entry
